propositions: The autodeploy review-drain fixture copied full os.environ and returned it in the box fixture value, which pytest default-long traceback rendered through 240-character saferepr, exposing ambient credentials early in the environment mapping.
The repaired fixture now passes only a narrow allowlist (PATH plus explicit harness variables DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX and HEALTH_TIMEOUT) instead of copying the full environment.
A synthetic sentinel injected before PATH in the ambient environment appeared in pytest failure output before the fix but is absent after the fix.
Seven sibling test fixtures in autodeploy modules employ the same dict(os.environ)-inside-rendered-fixture pattern and require equivalent repair or follow-up tracking.
The nested pytest test oracle created .pytest_cache artifacts in REPO_ROOT until `-p no:cacheprovider` and `--basetemp` redirection were added to sandbox test artifacts.
